fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, then passed 91/91 selftests plus CLI/GUI version and ULTIMATE UFO complete/activity-control checks. limitations: ULTIMATE UFO complete catalog represents the 126-instance constructor allocation/hierarchy baseline; it is not a claim that all phase-gated members are simultaneously rendered or gameplay-active.
ULTIMATE UFO numbered state catalogs are controller-activity subsets derived from col/dis phase flags; zero flags are not interpreted as render invisibility.

No fresh real-retail bos_015*.gmx assembled glTF was produced in dev9 because those proprietary GMXs were not present in the persistent research Library; the exporter resolves exact named locators from user-selected local GMXs at runtime.
D0-D3 procedural parent rotations are recorded as runtime metadata at their constructor-baseline 0/360-degree orientations; dev9 does not invent a sampled later-phase angular pose.
HORNET state-6 propagation and prism-wall catalogs remain runtime families rather than one canonical random result.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meter conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
Assembly export produces a combined glTF viewing/editing scene; it does not claim the retail game stores or accepts one merged native GMX.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
